# bugs #3875: mcs51: tests/bug-3873.c passes on trunk for the large and huge models and is still disabled

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3875/
- Category: [Trivial fixes](../../fix-trivial.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Apply the patch, which enables the test again except for the small model, and close.
- Patch: [bugs-3875.patch](../../patches/bugs-3875.patch), commit [`84455eb24`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/84455eb242e437b8d470d63b0817f550912110f3). Applies to r17176 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The failure does not occur on r17158. In trunk a guard in `tests/bug-3873.c` that names this
ticket disables the test for every mcs51 model. After the guard is removed, the test passes for
mcs51-medium, mcs51-large, mcs51-huge, mcs51-small-stack-auto, and mcs51-large-stack-auto. The
revision that corrected the behavior was not identified.

For mcs51-small the test does not link, because its data does not fit into internal RAM.

## Fix

The patch replaces the guard with one that skips the test only for mcs51 in the small model
without `--stack-auto`. The comment on the new guard is `Lack of memory`. The patch changes no
compiler source.
